title: M/C Journal 'twitter' Issue Now Out!
snippet: A news announcement covering the launch of a special issue of the M/C Journal reflecting on Twitter's legacy. Professor Fabio Giglietto is highlighted as a key co-author (alongside Cornelius Puschmann) of an article analyzing the history of Twitter/X data access for research purposes.
description: A blog post on snurb.info announcing the release of M/C Journal's special 'twitter' issue, highlighting Fabio Giglietto as co-author of an article analyzing the history of academic data access to Twitter/X.

title: How Facebook's Algorithmic Tweaks Affected Engagement with News URLs over Time
snippet: Media live-blogging of Fabio Giglietto's research presentation at the 2026 International Communication Association (ICA) conference in Cape Town [1.1.2]. The post details Giglietto's findings on how Facebook's algorithmic shifts over six years affected the reach and visibility of news, noting how it penalized heavily partisan shares while benefiting higher-quality news domains.
description: An academic session summary covering Fabio Giglietto's presentation at the ICA 2026 conference on how Facebook's algorithmic tweaks affected engagement with news URLs.

title: Disinfo Update: Civil Society Mobilises | Council of Europe Actions | MFF Budgets
snippet: In its June 10, 2026 newsletter, the EU DisinfoLab features Fabio Giglietto's co-authored research 'How partisan alignment, journalistic quality, and algorithmic governance shape what millions see on Facebook' as key reading in its Research and Platform Governance section.
description: An EU DisinfoLab newsletter featuring Fabio Giglietto's co-authored research on how partisan alignment, journalistic quality, and algorithmic governance influence content visibility on Facebook.

title: SMSociety 2026 Conference Programme

description: An announcement for the International Conference on Social Media & Society listing Professor Fabio Giglietto as an expert panelist discussing future pathways for social media research following the closure of CrowdTangle.

title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
snippet: A news article detailing how Fabio Giglietto's study on algorithmic governance of political content became the focal point of a major national debate, prompting a special investigative segment on the Rai3 television program 'Report' and leading to a formal inquiry in the European Parliament regarding Meta's systemic risks.
description: A news article highlighting a study by Fabio Giglietto of the University of Urbino on Meta's algorithmic governance of political content, which sparked national debate and prompted a European Parliament inquiry.

title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
snippet: An investigative news article discussing Fabio Giglietto's research based on over 2.5 million Facebook posts, focusing on how conspiracy-driven and anti-establishment pages successfully bypassed platform filters during critical election periods.
description: An article covering Professor Fabio Giglietto's research analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, focusing on how political extremist pages bypassed Meta's filters to gain visibility during elections.
